profile.what: Vertically integrated maker of off-patent oral solid medicines: active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), pharmaceutical formulation intermediates (PFI: ready-to-press granules sold to other tablet makers) and finished dosages (FD: tablets and capsules, mostly sold in the US under customers' and its own labels), plus a peptide CDMO (contract development and manufacturing for drug innovators) bought in Apr-2025 (Senn Chemicals, Switzerland).
profile.founded: 1984 (Triton Laboratories, paracetamol); listed 2005 as Granules India; Hyderabad
profile.plants: 10 manufacturing facilities: API at Bonthapally (34,560 TPA) and Jeedimetla (4,800 TPA); PFI at Gagillapur (23,200 TPA) and Jeedimetla (1,440 TPA); FD at Gagillapur (26.8 bn dosages a year), Genome Valley (10 bn) and Chantilly, Virginia (GPI, 1.5 bn); Vizag Unit IV (API, 380 KL) and Unit V (oncology API and FD, 1.1 bn dosages); GPAK packaging in Virginia; Senn Chemicals (peptides, Zurich area)
profile.rnd: Six R&D centres (Genome Valley, Pragathi Nagar, GPI Virginia, Pune, Ascelis peptides lab at IIT Hyderabad, Senn Switzerland); 441 scientists; R&D Rs88 cr in Q1FY27 (6.0% of sales); 153 dossiers filed globally, 103 approved incl. tentative; 112 DMFs

q1fy27.usRank: No.1 in 10 of 35 US products, top-3 in 18 (IQVIA MAT May-2026); GPI 27th among US generic companies (74th five years ago); 4th largest in US controlled substances
q1fy27.filings: 5 FD and 4 API filings in Q1; 2nd sole first-to-file (sodium oxybate ER oral suspension, brand ~USD267 mn); 25 ANDAs under approval (US TAM ~USD40 bn brand + generic)
q1fy27.costs: Opening US inventory insulated Q1 gross margin from West Asia-led raw-material, packing and freight inflation; calibrated price actions and pass-through being pursued for coming quarters (CFO). Some legacy-5 supply was held back because prices could not be passed on (ED)

guidance.text: 'We are confident it will continue' (CMD, asked about FY27 growth after five quarters of ~20%+); no numeric revenue guidance
22-23% range 'we expect that to continue' (CMD); RM pressures high but mix toward complex generics helps
~Rs600 cr for FY27 (Rs89 cr spent in Q1); FY27 projects: a new API facility, IT/digitalisation, a US warehouse/distribution centre (Rs200 cr plus)
About Rs2,000 cr of organic capex over the next three to four years across complex generics, oncology, peptide CDMO, US operations, manufacturing and R&D; milestone-based
Net working capital to sales in the ~33% range (FY26 33%; Q1FY27 29% after lower US receivables)
Flattish to slightly higher in FY27 (CFO, Apr-2026) - superseded by the Rs1,097 cr warrant balance in Sep-2026: 'we are now in a consolidated net cash position' (CFO, 29-Sep-2026)

PAT positive in FY27; Q1 x4 is 'the minimum' FY27 revenue; ~USD50 mn revenue run-rate with 30%+ EBITDA margin in about three years, >USD100 mn in five; 3 customer wins of USD10 mn+ a year as proof points
Utilisation 'very low' in Q1FY27, to cross 50% by the end of FY27 (CFO)

~9 US launches in FY27 pending FDA approval; 18 approvals pending: 9 to launch as soon as the FDA clears Gagillapur (market ~USD11 bn), 1 from GPI, the rest IP-dependent. No new controlled-substance launches in FY27 (1-2 in FY28) per the ED in Jul-2026; GPI President (29-Sep-2026): 3 controlled products to be launched over the next ~12 months incl. Adderall IR
Payout 'conservative so far'; the board will relook at increasing it (CFO)

plants.lastFda: 26-Aug to 6-Sep-2024: six Form 483 observations; OAI (Dec-2024); Warning Letter 320-25-48 dated 26-Feb-2025
plants.status30Sep: Under warning letter. Existing products keep shipping (production paused only a few days in Sep-2024); new approvals from the site are on hold (9 ANDAs, ~USD11 bn market). Remediation 'essentially complete', >100 CAPAs closed, FDA meeting Jan-2026 and all responses filed Feb-2026; re-inspection awaited ('expect them to come anytime now', ED, 29-Sep-2026). TGA Australia inspection Apr-2026 with no critical findings; ANVISA GMP certificate

molecules.share: Legacy generics were 56% and non-legacy products 44% of FY26 revenue (AR FY26 value-creation page). The AR's BRSR life-cycle table attributes ~65% of turnover to products built on three APIs (paracetamol, metformin, guaifenesin) including their PFI and FD stages. Integrated generics (products built on own API: the legacy molecules) fell from 63% of FD revenue in FY25 to 52% in FY26 and 46% in Q1FY27.
molecules.integration: Granules makes the API, the PFI and the tablet for paracetamol, metformin and other key molecules ('API self-sufficiency for major FD products ... cost advantage', Q4FY26 deck); one of only two vertically integrated paracetamol suppliers in the US OTC market (GPI President, 29-Sep-2026)

priceTrend.text: API revenue fell from Rs1,341 cr (FY23) to Rs619 cr (FY25) and PFI from Rs902 cr to Rs429 cr as post-COVID API prices fell (Chinese supply) and more API went into Granules' own tablets
priceTrend.src: ar26 division history; Elara initiation (FD:API mix 50:50 FY23, 77:23 FY25)

priceTrend.text: API +10% from new APIs sold outside, not price: 'there were no price increases we wish we had, whereas raw material prices have gone up and are still going up' (CMD, 29-Apr-2026)

Cost pressure on the 'legacy 5' business: Granules could not pass on much of the cost increase to long-term customers and held back some supply; Europe flat QoQ partly for this reason (ED, 21-Jul-2026)
Ibuprofen shortages in developed markets and raw-material inflation: near-term pressure, price pass-through 'could be with a lag' (CFO, 29-Sep-2026)

molecules.src: ar26; q4ppt p.9; q1ppt p.10; q4call; q1call; webinar

controlledSubstances.text: US Schedule II ADHD and opioid products made at GPI Virginia (API and dosage must be US-made). Granules is the 3rd largest US controlled-substance manufacturer by value (8th in Jul-2025, IQVIA); 8 ADHD products approved, 7 marketed, top-3 in 6 of 7; Adderall XR share 5% (2024) to 29% (Aug-2026); No.2 generic lisdexamfetamine; DEA quota rises every year. Pipeline covers 87% of methylphenidate value (6% addressed today); Adderall IR and another amphetamine product to be launched in coming months; 2 opioid-APAP ANDAs (oxycodone/APAP, hydrocodone/APAP) entered ~a year ago
controlledSubstances.ftf: Two sole first-to-file ANDAs in the public domain: generic Lumryz (sodium oxybate ER) and generic Dyanavel XR (amphetamine ER oral suspension), combined US market >USD350 mn with potential 180-day exclusivity, timing subject to litigation; one more likely sole FTF in oncology; 4-5 further FTFs commercialising FY30-FY34

divisionMargins: Not disclosed by division. What is known: the peptide CDMO lost Rs44.5 cr at EBITDA level in FY26 (EBITDA positive in Q4FY26; loss Rs12.4 cr in Q1FY27); complex generics carry structurally higher margins than integrated generics (company); API is the lowest-margin part (commodity, Chinese competition); the 15-point gross-margin gain FY22-FY26 came with the mix shift from API/PFI to FD and to complex generics.
